extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar.

extDescription.message: Connects the Kaiord workout editor to Garmin Connect via your browser session
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

checking.description: Status verdict while the popup probes the connection.

checkingCause.description: Status cause sentence shown while the probe runs.

connected.description: Status verdict when the bridge is connected.

connectedCause.message: Reading your Garmin Connect data with access Kaiord minted from an earlier sign-in.
connectedCause.description: Status cause sentence for the connected state. Names the minted access rather than a live session: the bridge holds OAuth tokens, not a browser session.

noGarminAccess.description: Status verdict when the bridge's last read of Garmin Connect did not succeed. Deliberately cause-neutral — the extension cannot tell an expired token from a Garmin outage.

noGarminAccessCause.message: Kaiord could not read from Garmin Connect. Signing in again mints fresh access; if you are already signed in, Garmin may be temporarily unavailable.
noGarminAccessCause.description: Status cause sentence for the no-access state. Names both possibilities without asserting either, and keeps the sign-in action meaningful.

noGarminAccessCauseSince.message: Kaiord has read nothing from Garmin Connect since $date$. Signing in again mints fresh access; if you are already signed in, Garmin may be temporarily unavailable.
noGarminAccessCauseSince.description: Dated variant of the no-access cause, used once an earlier popup open already recorded the outage. Claims only what the extension can establish — that IT has read nothing since that date — not that Garmin access expired then.

bridgeNotResponding.description: Status verdict when the extension's background worker times out.

bridgeNotRespondingCause.message: The extension's background worker did not answer. Try again.
bridgeNotRespondingCause.description: Status cause sentence for a background-worker timeout.

typeActivity.description: Capability chip for the Activity data type imported into Kaiord.

typeWorkoutBack.description: Capability chip for the Workout data type Kaiord pushes to Garmin Connect.

typeBodyCompositionBack.description: Capability chip for the Body Composition data type Kaiord pushes to Garmin Connect.

profileStale.message: Profile snapshot is stale. Open Kaiord to refresh.
profileStale.description: Athlete-card placeholder when the cached snapshot is stale.

noProfile.message: No profile yet. Open Kaiord to set FTP, pace, and HR.
noProfile.description: Athlete-card placeholder when no snapshot exists.

noThresholds.message: Profile has no thresholds yet. Open Kaiord to set FTP, pace, and HR.
noThresholds.description: Athlete-card placeholder when the snapshot has no threshold fields.

labelSport.description: Athlete-card field label for the active sport.

labelPace.description: Athlete-card field label for threshold running pace.

labelMaxHr.description: Athlete-card field label for maximum heart rate.

labelWeight.description: Athlete-card field label for body weight.

workoutLibrary.description: Rollup line showing the total number of stored workouts.

lastPush.description: Rollup line prefix for the most recent workout push.

captionSync.description: Caption above the sync rollup section.

updatedAgo.description: Athlete-card freshness line, e.g. 'Updated 10 minutes ago'.

updatedJustNow.description: Athlete-card freshness line for a very recent update.

momentsAgo.description: Relative time used in the last-push rollup line.

openEditor.description: Footer link that opens the Kaiord editor.

signInGarmin.description: Primary footer link in the no-access state. It is the useful action because signing in lets the bridge mint fresh OAuth access — NOT because the user is known to be signed out, which the extension cannot determine.

openGarmin.description: Secondary footer link opening Garmin Connect.

retry.description: Button that retries the connection check.

refresh.description: Accessible label for the header refresh button.
